title: Curved breach waves, wall clearance and rendering comparisons
context: The owner wants ground breaches to replace wave portals eventually, with short wide fissures, wall destruction, and creatures climbing out on the spherical world.
outcome: Portal Lab now wraps the breach onto a planet and schedules up to 96 real creature previews with fade/growth and a scripted slope route. Crack width and outer reach are independent. Eighty-one wall fixtures test radial clearance before the default emergence delay, while TRON and Battlezone palette previews keep dark depth-writing surfaces and bowl contours. Actual dungeon wall mutation, navigation rebuild, portal replacement and FX-schema promotion remain future integration work.
evidence: npm run check and npm run build passed
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --sinkhole passed planet, emergence, 24-creature waves, flat reference, both rendering palettes, partial wall clearance, reset and disposal
